desc: The VICTRA-12 Mount Assembly is a bit different than your ordinary mount assembly. YHM's threads into the end of your shotgun's barrel using the standard choke threads to mount the suppressor to the shotgun, but it does not choke your shot. That is handled by their unique front-installed choke. Each mount is shotgun-manufacturer specific and they offer a multitude of mounts that function with most popular shotguns.
